question: What is the total rental payment revenue for each film category?
query: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM pagila.payment AS p JOIN pagila.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN pagila.film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN pagila.category AS c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many times have films featuring the actor Penelope Guiness been rented?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM pagila.rental AS r JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN pagila.film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = i.film_id JOIN pagila.actor AS a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: What is the total payment revenue by customer country?
query: SELECT co.country, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM pagila.payment AS p JOIN pagila.customer AS cu ON cu.customer_id = p.customer_id JOIN pagila.address AS ad ON ad.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN pagila.city AS ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id JOIN pagila.country AS co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country

question: How many rentals has each store made?
query: SELECT i.store_id, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM pagila.rental AS r JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id

question: How many rentals were there for films in each language?
query: SELECT l.name AS language, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM pagila.rental AS r JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN pagila.film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN pagila.language AS l ON l.language_id = f.language_id GROUP BY l.name

question: How many customers live in Canada?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM pagila.customer AS cu JOIN pagila.address AS ad ON ad.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN pagila.city AS ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id JOIN pagila.country AS co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: Which film categories has the customer Mary Smith rented from?
query: SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS category FROM pagila.rental AS r JOIN pagila.customer AS cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN pagila.film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN pagila.category AS c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE cu.first_name = 'MARY' AND cu.last_name = 'SMITH'

question: For each film category, how many films does it have and how many times have its films been rented?
query: WITH films AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS films FROM pagila.film_category GROUP BY category_id), rentals AS (SELECT fc.category_id, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM pagila.rental AS r JOIN pagila.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN pagila.film_category AS fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY fc.category_id) SELECT c.name AS category, f.films, COALESCE(rc.rentals, 0) AS rentals FROM pagila.category AS c JOIN films AS f ON f.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN rentals AS rc ON rc.category_id = c.category_id
note: Fan trap: counting films over the rental join counts rentals instead.
